stem:
Alok presses a drawing pin into soft clay with his thumb. Preeti presses a flat wooden block into the same clay with the same downward force.

Which statement about pressure on the clay is correct?

options.text: Pressure is greater under the pin tip, because the same force acts on a smaller contact area.
Pressure is smaller under the pin tip, because a smaller contact area always lowers pressure.
Pressure is the same in both cases, because the downward force is the same.
Pressure is greater under the flat block, because the block covers more clay.

teacher.key_rationale: Pressure rises when the same perpendicular force acts on a smaller contact area. The pin tip has the smaller area, so pressure is greater there.
